name: cash.blackpool/blackpool
title: Blackpool
description: Private payments for agents: shield, send, swap and bridge via ZK privacy pools on 4 EVM chains.

environmentVariables.name: BLACKPOOL_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated agent wallet (0x...). Never use a main wallet.

environmentVariables.name: BLACKPOOL_MCP_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated tool allow-list, e.g. balance,send,bridges

environmentVariables.name: BLACKPOOL_MCP_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose only read-only tools
